title: Tofu and pea curry
summary: Tofu and pea curry is a indian dinner built around firm tofu and frozen peas, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Tofu and pea curry. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add firm tofu and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and frozen peas.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until chopped tomatoes is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Tofu and pea curry before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Tofu and pea curry.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
